stories.title: DeepSeek reportedly raises $15B days after US restrictions
stories.explanation: DeepSeek reportedly raised $15 billion in funding, one of China's largest rounds, shortly after US restrictions were imposed on its technology. This significant investment will support its spending on AI infrastructure and open models.

stories.title: Patch the Planet: global response coordination as agents uncover critical vulnerabilities
stories.explanation: OpenAI's Patch the Planet initiative, using GPT-5.6 Sol, identified critical vulnerabilities in PHP, an open-source programming language. This demonstrates AI's capability in identifying significant security flaws and coordinating global responses.

stories.title: OpenAI's latest AI models are coming to Google Cloud and Antigravity
stories.explanation: OpenAI's latest GPT 6 and 6.1 models (Astra, Sol, Luna) will be available on Google Cloud's Model Garden and in Antigravity, Google’s agent-powered coding tool. This expands the availability of OpenAI's frontier models to Google Cloud customers, making Google the only large cloud provider offering access to all three leading closed LLMs.

stories.title: NVIDIA Cosmos Opens New Tools to Train, Evaluate and Deploy World Models
stories.explanation: NVIDIA expanded its Cosmos platform with new tools to accelerate data pipelines, train, evaluate, and optimize world models more efficiently. These tools, including Cosmos Data Factory blueprints, help developers build physical AI systems that understand and simulate the real world.

stories.title: NVIDIA Kumo Relational Outperforms Supervised Machine Learning on Relational Data, No Training Required
stories.explanation: NVIDIA released Kumo Relational, a pre-trained relational foundation model that makes predictions on enterprise databases without task-specific training. This is significant as it outperforms supervised machine learning on relational benchmarks, potentially changing how enterprises use AI for data analysis.

stories.title: This Startup Is All In on Recursive Self-Improvement. Its Latest Model Is Scary Good
stories.explanation: Recursive, a startup, released Flint, an open-weight AI coding model developed using recursive self-improvement (RSI). This demonstrates the potential of AI to build and improve AI, allowing a small team to create a world-class model quickly.

stories.title: Jensen Huang’s Vision for Europe Runs on Plug-In Data Centers
stories.explanation: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang unveiled the DSX Pod, a modular, plug-and-play AI factory for building data centers, at GTC in Berlin. This aims to address Europe's AI infrastructure needs and supports Nvidia's vision for AI agents and robotics.

stories.title: Empowering frontline maternal care with AI-assisted ultrasound
stories.explanation: Google Research demonstrated that AI-assisted ultrasound can enable non-sonographer operators to deliver expert-level gestational age assessments. This development is significant for expanding life-saving maternal care in low-resource settings globally.

stories.title: Claude Duet app is Anthropic’s bet on agents
stories.explanation: Anthropic launched Claude Duet, a new AI agent app aimed at professionals and small businesses for automating and managing tasks. This marks Anthropic's entry into the productivity-based AI assistant market.

stories.title: Hugging Face’s New AI Biology Model Lets You Chat With DNA
stories.explanation: Hugging Face released Carbon-X, a new open-source AI model that allows researchers to chat with DNA using natural language. This development aims to help in designing new drugs and genetic therapies by making DNA analysis more accessible.
